paragraphs: The official frontend web application for Engaze.com — an engaging dating and social discovery experience combining Tinder-style candidate discovery, mutual matching, persistent real-time chat, and random 1-to-1 WebRTC video matchmaking.
features: Modern Dating UI/UX: Built with a confident, dark-mode design system featuring Midnight charcoal foundations (#0B0D17), Coral-Pink to Sunset Orange gradients, glassmorphism app bars, and responsive layouts.

Tinder-Style Discovery: Interactive swipe cards with multi-photo carousels, interest badges, expandable bio modal, Like/Pass action buttons, keyboard arrow shortcuts, and an animated "It's a Match!" celebration modal.
Mutual Matches Hub: Dedicated matches screen with instant search filtering by name, avatar previews, and quick-action buttons to open private chat or launch a direct video call.

Persistent Private Messaging: Real-time 1-to-1 chat via Socket.IO with REST fallback, unread message badges, sent/delivered/read receipts, auto-scroll to latest message, and seamless mobile responsive drawer/list…

Random 1-to-1 WebRTC Video Matchmaking: Queue-based matching connecting two live users peer-to-peer with camera/mic controls, partner dating profile overlay card, skip-to-next partner, and clean disconnect handling.
